subject: Marketplace listing credit sync + reseller netback check - Acme
messages:

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing credit sync + reseller netback check - Acme

Hi Alex and team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick follow up on two items we promised to align on before the contract: listing credit behavior (how AWS/GCP will route credits/fees) and the reseller netback you noted for your channel partners. We want to make sure the private offer economics you expect are preserved once the PO is transacted via the marketplace.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm whether your procurement team expects the private-offer discount to be applied as a listing credit on invoice or as a post-invoice rebate?
- Do you have a preferred path for distributor pass-through (invoice routing to partner vs Amazon invoice + reseller rebate)?
- If possible, send the PO draft so we can validate invoice language with marketplace ops — Ben and I will loop marketplace sales.

Camila/Ben — I’ve CC’d you for ops + channel margin check. If we need to push an evidence pack (usage history / anchor volumes) to finalize the pass-through, we should identify the minimal set now.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <procurement@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing credit sync + reseller netback check - Acme

Sergio —

Appreciate the follow up. Attaching an initial PO (acme_po_draft_v1.pdf) — key items from our side: we need list-price parity on the invoice and then a marketplace credit applied back to Acme as an invoice-level credit. Our downstream partners expect a netback calculation on a monthly basis; they receive a single consolidated invoice from the marketplace and we then distribute to partners with the agreed pass-through slice.

Two clarifying notes:
1) We will need a clause that states Redwood will provide transaction-level evidence (invoice ids, dated usage) to validate credits for the partners.
2) Can Redwood confirm whether the private-offer discount will reduce the marketplace seller fee (that impacts netback) or if the fee is calculated on list price and then credits applied post-fee? That distinction changes the netback math for our channel.

If you can loop in marketplace sales/ops that'd be great — we need an estimate of gross-to-net timing so partners aren’t surprised.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Sr. Strategic Sourcing, Acme Analytics
procurement@acme.com

Ben here — quick context and asks for Marketplace Sales:
- Acme requires invoice-level credit (not post-invoice rebate) and expects a consolidated marketplace invoice to partners.
- They want transaction-level evidence for reconciliation.
- The big question: does the private-offer discount flow through as a reduction in Amazon's seller fee base, or is fee calculated on list price with a separate credit applied after fees?

Concrete asks to Marketplace Sales:
1) Confirm whether seller fee base is calculated on list price or discounted price for private offers.
2) If fee is on list price, is there a standard timing for crediting buyers so partners can reconcile monthly?
3) If there's any evidence template you require from Redwood to support partner netback (invoice ids, pricing tags), point us to it.

Appreciate the quick turn here — Acme is targeting signature by mid-August.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Team —

Recap and suggested workback to keep the deal on track:

1) Quick answers we need from Marketplace Sales (parallel ask by Ben):
   - Fee base calculation for private offers (list vs net price)
   - Standard credit timing (invoice offset window)
   - Any marketplace-required evidence format (CSV/JSON of invoice ids + amounts)

2) From Acme we need:
   - Final PO language or a redline noting the invoice-credit path (we have acme_po_draft_v1.pdf)
   - Partner list + expected % pass-through per partner (to validate sample netback)

3) Redwood deliverables:
   - I will assemble a minimal evidence pack template (channel_margin_workback.xlsx) and a short note we can share with Marketplace Sales to speed ops review.
   - Camila, please pull the last 90 days of similar marketplace invoices and tokenized invoice ids we can share (steamline PII) — aim to have that by EOD Friday.

If Marketplace Sales confirms fee accounting is on list price, we should prepare two netback scenarios (fee-on-list vs fee-on-discount) and show Acme the delta in dollars and % to their partners — helps them decide whether they want invoice-credit or rebate flow.

I'll attach the workback and drop a link to the mutual action plan.

Irene Choi
Director, Partnerships & Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
